description: Defines inline functions for supporting PDCCH search space configurations, including support checks for DCI formats, retrieval of DCI formats, and monitoring activity based on slot and configuration parameters.

methods.name: search_space_supports_dci_dl_format
methods.description: Checks if a given DCI downlink format is supported by the specified search space configuration.

methods.name: get_dl_dci_format
methods.description: Retrieves the downlink DCI format based on the search space configuration.

methods.name: get_ul_dci_format
methods.description: Retrieves the uplink DCI format based on the search space configuration.

methods.name: is_pdcch_monitoring_active
methods.description: Determines if a PDCCH search space is actively monitored in a given slot according to 3GPP TS 38.213 section 10.1.
